question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**powers**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context involves the king gaining a supernatural ability from a divine source.
 
• The appropriate noun describes the newfound influence or capability granted by the wish.
 
• "**Powers**" (क्षमता) aligns with the narrative of Midas receiving an extraordinary capability.
 
• Other options ("**legacies**", "**awards**", "**visuals**") do not fit into the context of the supernatural ability gained by Midas.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Once there was a king named Midas who was granted a **wish__ by Dionysus, the god of wine. For his wish, Midas asked that whatever he *__touched__* would turn to gold. Despite Dionysus’ efforts to prevent it, Midas pleaded that this was a fantastic wish, and so, it was bestowed. Excited about his newly-earned *__powers__*, Midas started touching all kinds of things, turning each item into pure gold. But soon, Midas became *(4)________*. As he picked up a piece of food, he found he couldn’t eat it. It had turned to gold in his hand. Hungry, Midas groaned, “I’ll starve! Perhaps this was not such an excellent wish after all!” Seeing his dismay, Midas’ *(5)________ *daughter threw her arms around him to comfort him, and she, too, turned to gold. “The golden touch is no blessing,” Midas cried.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Legacies **(विरासतें): “Legacies” refers to what is passed down from the past, unsuitable for the immediate context of newfound abilities.
 
• **Awards **(पुरस्कार): “Awards” refers to honours or prizes, not fitting the context of supernatural capabilities.
 
• **Visuals **(दृश्यों): “Visuals” refers to images or aspects visible to the eye, which is unrelated to the powers granted to Midas.
